text:
Kayla (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Maya Lin will be stepping in as Interim Head of Platform Partnerships effective Mon 4/4. We're splitting Platform Partnerships out of Growth Partnerships for clearer ownership. This creates two backfill reqs (Sr Partnerships PM + Partnerships Ops lead). Tracking doc: https://redwoodintra/confluence/platform-partnerships-reorg :tada:

Maya Lin: really excited to jump in — thanks everyone. I'll run weekly 1:1s with the existing partners team to stabilize handoffs. happy to meet folks asynchronously this week.

Priya Natarajan: congrats Maya! who will you report to during the interim? will this affect the runtime/product reporting?

Kayla (People Ops): Maya will report to Diego (Head of Platform) for the interim. Product/reporting lines remain the same for now; Diego and Maya will surface any overlaps for follow-up.

Diego Morales: adding that we'll do a 30/60/90 plan in the shared doc. no org-wide product changes today.

Patrick (Recruiting): noted on the two reqs. target: post Sr Partnerships PM by EOW, Ops lead by next week. I'll own job descriptions and panel scheduling. can we confirm interview panel & rubric?

Evan Carter: recommend a 1-week shadow rotation from Growth Partnerships folks to transfer context. also suggest a small on-call rota for urgent partner incidents while we backfill.

Allie (Hiring Manager): +1 to shadow rota. i'll volunteer Sam and Noor for initial overlap. also can we add a PM-specific take-home exercise (30-60m)?

Ash Sinha: compensation approvals for Sr PM will need director sign-off. Kayla/Peter pls loop finance early so we don't block offers.

Kayla (People Ops): will loop Finance + Legal today. Maya — do you want to run the JDs by me before we post?

Maya Lin: yes please — i'll drop drafts by EOD Fri. i'll also post a short bio and 30/60/90 note to the team channel Monday.

Patrick (Recruiting): pulling panel: Diego, Allie, Evan, one IC from partners (Sam), and a cross-functional PM. will share calendar slots tomorrow.

Onboarding Bot: New interim leader onboarding checklist started for Maya Lin. Next steps:
```
- Welcome call (People Ops + Manager) scheduled
- Access requests: Confluence, Partners dashboard, PagerDuty
- Shadow schedule: Growth Partners (week 1)
- 30/60/90 template assigned
```

Kayla (People Ops): thanks all — cross-posting this update to #eng and #product for visibility. if you have questions or want to volunteer for interview panels, ping Patrick or me. :thumbsup:
